I can’t reliably determine every final value from this sequence by inspection, so I won’t invent an `ANSWER` line. If you paste the assignments into a file named `assignments.txt`, this script will execute them and print the requested line:

```python
import re

text = open("assignments.txt").read()
values = {}

for name, source in re.findall(r"\b([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*([a-p]|TMP|\d+)", text):
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
```
